issues.defect: Outstanding received advance, withheld/blocked money, costs and gross unaccepted work are summed as cash not held. Stock, cost flow and contractual exposure are not additive cash shortages.

counterexample.assumption: Advance of 1000000 received today and remains fully available; no work, withholdings, expenses or security deposit.

issues.fix_rule: Separate advance exposure, actual withheld/blocked money, paid costs and work receivable. Remove the single money-not-with-us total and the claim that its ratio to monthly need proves funding runway. Require actual cash, dates and forecast payments for liquidity assessment.
gates: Advance-only case must not become an unavailable-cash amount.
Guarantee face amount is not cash expenditure. Fee and actual collateral are separate.
100000 gross work including 10000 retained must not be added to the same 10000 again.
Retention base follows contract and underlying certificates, not an unconditional percent of net payments.

issues.where: 01 checklist: no explicit suspension right means advance exists only on paper
issues.defect: Categorical loss of statutory protection is unsupported.
issues.fix_rule: Check due advance, linkage to work, obstruction, contract terms and written notice; absence of a repeated clause is not by itself absence of a statutory remedy.

issues.defect: Irrevocability is equated with automatic payment; end-of-obligations wording is treated as a valid unlimited guarantee.
issues.fix_rule: Review the guarantee itself, stated term, circumstances, documentary demand and bank agreement. Irrevocability describes amendment/revocation, not automatic compliance of any demand.

issues.defect: Unilateral setoff is presented as necessarily improper; unsigned work is described as automatically zeroed.
issues.fix_rule: Distinguish contractual advance deduction, payment adjustment and statutory setoff. Check statement, grounds and restrictions. Distinguish contractual evidentiary risk from established loss of the value of completed work.

issues.defect: Reply consistency promises no surprises; absence of reply predicts all future correspondence.
issues.fix_rule: Remove outcome guarantees and predictions; preserve correspondence, reconcile final contract text and identify unresolved matters.

primary_work_next: Author separate revised candidates; validate model semantics before native numeric checks; 99 PDF and full bundle/native/visual gates remain open.
